name: GG4
summary: **GG4** is a [[kind:cut|cut]] found in Nevada in 2011 by Joesy Whales and Lone Watty, who later founded [[breeder:GG Strains]]. A hermaphrodite [[chem-sister|Chem Sister]] plant pollinated nearby [[sour-dubb|Sour Dubb]] and [[chocolate-diesel|Chocolate Diesel]] plants, and one phenotype from that seed was kept. A trademark dispute with the adhesive maker led to its renaming from Gorilla Glue to GG4.
